# CBDB-Desktop: Browser label revisions, 2026-10-26

Third form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table. The Browser draws on BROWSE (the browse form's own controls), BIO (the biography form, whose tabs and Basic Information fields the Browser reproduces) and the biography subforms SAN, SF_ADDR, SF_STATUS, SF_POFF, SF_PADDR, SF_ASD, SF_KIN, SF_TEXTS and SEN (the record tabs). Decisions from the Association Pairs and Associations reviews (储存 for Store, 匯出 / 导出 for Export, 指數 over 索引, translated "Display Language:") are applied here. Changes are in the Browser form's index.html only. The page script was syntax-checked, and every tab's headers were rendered in all three languages in a scripted browser (jsdom) with stand-in data. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked.

## How to revert a label

All labels are in the translations object near the top of the script, read through T(key). To go back to earlier wording, change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. In the english and traditional blocks each new key has a comment naming its FormLabels row.

Before these changes, the left-panel controls and every record-tab header showed the same text in all three languages. Deleting a key from the traditional and simplified blocks restores that for one label, because T() falls back to English. A copy of the file before the header changes (LBL-24, LBL-25) was kept as index.before-headers.html.

## LBL-24: Record-tab column headers

## Conventions

- **Chinese.** Taken from the subform rows of FormLabels wherever one exists. Several tabs show the same item twice, once romanized or in English and once in Chinese. Following the subforms' own patterns, the first column gets 拼音 when it holds pinyin (SAN 4 別名拼音, SF_TEXTS 1 著述名稱拼音) and (英文) when it holds an English description (SF_POS 5 財產(英文)).
- **English mode.** Headers are unchanged except for five, where the Access subform names the column more precisely: Name Type and Name Type (Chinese) (SAN 6), Posting Type (SF_POFF 3), Assumed Post? (SF_POFF 6), and Associate (SF_ASD 13, SEN 7). As before, some Chinese-data columns have Chinese headers in English mode (地名, 官名, 書名 …) and others English ones ("Chinese"); this mix was not changed.
- **Years.** The subforms' English varies (From / To, Began / Ended, Year). The HTML's First Year / Last Year was kept on every tab for consistency; the Chinese is 始年 / 終年 throughout.
- **Sort tooltips** ("Sort on …") are still in English.

## Before and after

In every row below, the header before this change was the English text in all three languages, except where the English column shows a Chinese header. The **English** column shows the English-mode header after the change; a value in **bold** is changed.

## Kinship (SF_KIN)

| Key | English | Traditional | Simplified | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| knName | Kin Name | 親戚姓名拼音 | 亲戚姓名拼音 | SF_KIN 4 |
| knNameChn | Chinese | 親戚姓名 | 亲戚姓名 | SF_KIN 4 |
| knSex | Sex | 性別 | 性别 | As Basic Information |
| knRel | Relationship | 親屬關係類別 | 亲属关系类别 | SF_KIN 3 |
| knUp | Up | 尊輩 | 尊辈 | No row; see note |
| knDown | Down | 卑輩 | 卑辈 | No row; see note |
| knMarriage | Marriage | 姻親 | 姻亲 | No row; see note |
| knColl | Collateral | 旁系 | 旁系 | No row; see note |

**Up / Down / Marriage / Collateral.** These columns count the steps in a kinship path: ascendant generations, descendant generations, marriage links and collateral (sibling) links. 尊輩 / 卑輩 are the formal terms for senior and junior generations of kin (as in 尊親屬 / 卑親屬 in the legal kinship vocabulary); 長輩 / 晚輩 are everyday equivalents. 前輩 / 後輩 were not used, because they usually mean seniors and juniors in a career or field rather than kin. 姻親 is affinal kin; 旁系 (collateral line) was preferred to 兄弟 because collateral steps run through sisters as well as brothers. The earlier suggestion was 上 / 下 / 婚 / 旁. | knIndexYear | Index Year | 指數年 | 指数年 | BIO 2 | | knAddr | Address | 地名 | 地名 | No row |

## LBL-25: Redraw on language change

The record tabs are drawn once, when first opened. Since their headers now come from T(), setLanguage redraws every record tab already loaded for the current person, from _tabCache, without fetching again. Export Profile writes the headers in the language showing at the time.

## Question for the project manager: extra rows in BrowserLabelTranslations.xlsx

## Should those extra rows be added to FormLabels?

The comments in the Browser's translation block cite a spreadsheet called BrowserLabelTranslations.xlsx, sheet "BIO", and give row numbers (c_label_id) for each label. Rows 1–53 agree with FormLabels BIO 1–53. The comments also cite rows that are **not** in FormLabels, whose BIO rows stop at 53:

| Row cited | Label (as the comments describe it) | Chinese used in the HTML | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| 54 | Institutions | 社交機構 (now changed to 社會機構, LBL-23) | Social Institutions tab |
| 55 | Sources | 出處 | Sources tab |
| 56 | Household Status | 戶籍狀態 | Basic Information field |
| 58 | Person ID | 人物代碼 | Summary strip "ID:" and the CBDB ID field |

No row 57 is cited. The likeliest explanations are that BrowserLabelTranslations.xlsx is a later, extended copy of the BIO rows, or that rows were added to the Access FormLabels table after the export provided for this review. If these rows are added to FormLabels, row 54 should carry 社會機構 / 社会机构.

## Issues

1. **Association address (user checking).** asAddr shows assocAddrName. If this is the place where the association took place (ASSOC_DATA.c_addr_id), SF_ASD 19 gives "Association Place" / 社會關係發生地. If it is the associate's own address, 地名 is right. Kept as Address / 地名 until checked.
1. **Kinship Up / Down / Marriage / Collateral.** No FormLabels rows. Now 尊輩 / 卑輩 / 姻親 / 旁系, following the user's description of the columns (see the Kinship table). Check width: four columns of numbers now have two-character headers.
1. **Headers with no rows.** 官名英譯, 機構拼音 / 機構 (Offices), 著述類別 (Texts), 書名拼音 / 書名 / 連結 (Sources) and the whole Social Institutions tab are my wording.
1. **Entry "Associate".** The column shows the associate's name, but falls back to the association description when there is no name. The header now says Associate (SEN 7).
1. **English mix in Chinese-data columns.** In English mode some Chinese columns have Chinese headers (地名, 官名, 書名, 社會區分, 入仕法, 姓名, 社會關係, 類別) and others "Chinese" or "(Chinese)". Left as before; could be made uniform.
1. **Title bar.** "CBDB — Browser" has no id and is not translated (same as Associations).
1. **Messages.** "Showing N of M", "Loading…", "No … records found.", the status bar, the export overlay messages and sort tooltips are English only.
